B: very narrow opening with teeth close together for consonants and EE.
C: medium opening, unrounded, for EH/AE.
D: widest vertical opening for AA, with natural subdued teeth visible.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: small rounded, puckered UW/OW/W mouth.
G: upper teeth touching the lower lip for F/V.
H: tongue raised behind the upper teeth for L, with an opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle mouth, matching the source neutral mouth.

Keep all nine poses anatomically plausible and clearly distinct while retaining the source's modest mouth size and muted palette. A and X should match the source's neutral closed mouth as closely as possible. No changes to surrounding face pixels.
